title: My smart speaker started answering questions I never asked. Last night it answered one about my own bedroom.
story:
Last Tuesday, just after midnight, my smart speaker said, "Yes, he is still standing there." I hadn't said a word.

I laughed it off. Those things mishear background noise all the time. I checked the history in the app and found nothing, no request, no recording, just a blank line with a timestamp.

The next night it did it again. I was brushing my teeth in the bathroom, and from the kitchen I heard it say, "He is closer than before." I stood very still with the toothbrush in my mouth, listening to the apartment hum.

On the third night I asked it out loud, "Who is he?" It paused for a long time. Then it said, in the same cheerful voice it uses for the weather, "He says you already know."

I unplugged it. I carried it to the hallway closet and shut the door, and I slept with every light on.

This morning, I opened the app again. The history had a new entry, logged at four in the morning. It wasn't a question. It was a single answer, from the speaker I had unplugged, in a closet, across the apartment.

The answer read, "He is standing behind the door now."

I am sitting on my bed facing the closet.

It just said thank you.
premise: smart speaker answers unasked questions about a presence; it keeps talking after being unplugged
